title: Agentic AI Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (Agentic AI)

Salary: Up to £65,000

Location: Bristol

Technology: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Next.js, Agentic AI

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join a growing technology business developing innovative software solutions and embracing AI-driven development.

You'll join a collaborative engineering team, initially focusing on building and improving integrations with third-party platforms, applications and services, while also contributing to the development of the wider software platform.

This is a predominantly backend-focused position, although you'll have the opportunity to work across the full stack.

The business is particularly interested in engineers who are already incorporating AI and agentic workflows into their development process and are keen to explore how these technologies can improve software delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test and maintain full stack applications, backend services and APIs.

  • Build and improve integrations with third-party platforms, including Microsoft applications, e-commerce systems and authentication services.

  • Take ownership of features from initial design through to production, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable and maintainable.

  • Incorporate AI coding agents and agentic workflows into everyday development, including implementation, testing, refactoring and troubleshooting.

  • Work closely with other engineers, Product and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvements to engineering practices.

  • Support junior engineers through knowledge sharing, pairing and constructive feedback.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Commercial experience developing full stack applications or backend services using modern programming languages.

  • Strong understanding of backend development, API design and software engineering principles.

  • Experience with automated testing, code reviews and deploying applications into production.

  • Practical experience incorporating AI coding agents and agentic workflows into the software development lifecycle, with an understanding of their capabilities and limitations.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of technical tasks.

Desirable:

  • Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript or Next.js.

  • Experience developing integrations with external APIs, platforms or third-party services.

  • Exposure to Microsoft integrations, e-commerce platforms or authentication systems.

  • Knowledge of cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation.

Why Apply?

You'll be joining an engineering team that values curiosity, collaboration and technical innovation, with the opportunity to work on meaningful development challenges.

The business is actively investing in AI-assisted engineering practices and encourages developers to explore new approaches while maintaining high standards of software quality.

This opportunity would suit a capable Full Stack Engineer who enjoys hands-on development, wants to develop greater technical ownership and is interested in shaping how AI is used within modern software engineering.

Reasonable Adjustments:

Respect and equality are core values to us. We are proud of the diverse and inclusive community we have built, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and perspectives. Our success is driven by our people, united by the spirit of partnership to deliver the best resourcing solutions for our clients.

If you need any help or adjustments during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know when you apply or talk to the recruiters directly so we can support you.
